# RISC0 ProgramBinary golden

`program_binary_3_0_5.hex` is the complete output of the upstream
`risc0_binfmt::ProgramBinary` encoder for user bytes `guest-fixture` and kernel
bytes `kernel-fixture`. It is not generated by the local derived encoder.

Regenerate it with Cargo in a temporary directory, pinning the upstream crate
exactly:

```bash
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
cargo init --bin --name risc0_golden_generator "${tmp}"
cargo add --manifest-path "${tmp}/Cargo.toml" risc0-binfmt@=3.0.5
cp rules_monorepo_rust/zkvm/private/testdata/generate_program_binary_golden.rs \
  "${tmp}/src/main.rs"
cargo run --quiet --locked --manifest-path "${tmp}/Cargo.toml" \
  > rules_monorepo_rust/zkvm/private/testdata/program_binary_3_0_5.hex
```

The checked-in artifact was generated with this command and is compared
byte-for-byte by `risc0_program_binary_test`.
